title: Classic Buttermilk Pancakes
description: Tall, fluffy diner-style pancakes with crisp, buttery edges.

items: 3 tbsp melted butter, plus more for the pan
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir just until combined — lumps are fine. Rest the batter 5 minutes.
Heat a griddle or skillet over medium heat and brush with butter. Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on top and the edges look set, about 2 minutes, then flip and cook 1–2 minutes more.

notes: No buttermilk? Stir 2 tbsp lemon juice into 2 cups milk and let it stand 5 minutes.
